== Summary ==
[[Dan Bojanowski]], former Decipher brand manager, in the portrait ICv2 published with the news of his hiring by Renegade Game Studios in 2017. Uploaded unchanged.

* '''Source:''' [https://icv2.com/articles/news/view/38882/renegade-adds-dan-bojanowski Renegade Adds Dan Bojanowski], ICv2 (9 November 2017). The article lists his past roles, including "Decipher (Brand Manager)". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027201418/https://icv2.com/articles/news/view/38882/renegade-adds-dan-bojanowski Internet Archive]. Image: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027201313id_/https://icv2.com/images/uploads/dcf6edc53179bbde3656f09e4a369161075956aa5a0f0a4b72b8d5f5.jpg uploaded image] (Wayback SHA-1 matches this file).
* '''Photographer:''' unknown (published by ICv2).
* '''Date:''' published 9 November 2017
* '''Identification:''' the article is about Dan Bojanowski and this is its only portrait.

== Licensing ==
Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a portrait published by ICv2 with a news item about him, used only to identify a former Decipher brand manager on his article on a non-commercial fan wiki. No free photograph of him is known, and this use cannot harm any market for the original.
